patthana21.30:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā hetu micchatta niyato dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.30:2.1: na hetuṃ na sammatta niyataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu sammatta niyato dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.30:3.1: na hetuṃ na aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. na na hetuṃ na aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. (gaṇitakena tīṇi.) na hetuṃ na maggārammaṇaṃ
